name: Dispatch release.yaml on cplieger/${{ matrix.repo }}
run:
set -euo pipefail
# A stub predating the input answers "unexpected inputs" (HTTP 422);
# only that rejection falls back to a plain, always-publishing dispatch.
if ! gh workflow run release.yaml -R "cplieger/${REPO}" --ref "$BRANCH" \
    -f skip_if_unchanged=true 2>/tmp/dispatch.err; then
  cat /tmp/dispatch.err
  grep -qi "unexpected inputs" /tmp/dispatch.err
  echo "::notice::cplieger/${REPO}: dispatch with skip_if_unchanged rejected; retrying without inputs"
  gh workflow run release.yaml -R "cplieger/${REPO}" --ref "$BRANCH"
fi
echo "Dispatched release.yaml on cplieger/${REPO}"
